verdict.rationale: The Asset Management and Funds page mentions the firm provides expertise 'across private equity, venture capital, and alternative asset management,' establishing that venture financing is within scope, but there is no dedicated venture-financing practice page, no mention of seed/Series A-through-late-stage equity rounds, and no deal volume or representative transaction list specific to VC financings. Missing for 10: dedicated venture financing/startup financing page, representative priced-round deal examples, and stated deal volume or round-stage coverage.
